thread:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: latency.p99 > 1.0s on route=embeddings-uswest for 6m. Severity: page

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident P-83921 created and routed to on-call.

sam (oncall): acked. looking. seeing p50 ~80ms, p95 ~300ms, p99 ~1.4s. spike correlates with small requests burst.

megan: @sam any recent changes to batcher or sidecar configs?

sam (oncall): there was a canary of batcher-config v2 rolled 12m ago to us-west sidecars. rolling back to verify.

ravi: I'm seeing head-of-line queueing in the sidecar logs. batcher is grouping tiny requests into huge batches and waiting for long tail. looks like BATCH_MAX_WAIT increased accidentally.

sam (oncall): ok quick mitigation: scale batcher replicas and reduce pending queue. rolling now.

sam (oncall): ```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/batcher-uswest --replicas=6
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/batcher-uswest BATCH_MAX_PENDING=50 BATCH_MAX_WAIT_MS=40
```

kate: good call. I'll watch dashboards. Linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood/ops/embeddings-uswest/latency?p=1m

incident-bot: alert duplicate suppressed for route=embeddings-uswest (muted by oncall).

megan: if scaling doesn't drop tail we should revert batcher-config v2. do we have rollout ID?

sam (oncall): rollout id: rc-batcher-2026-04-10-2. starting revert now.

sam (oncall): ```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/batcher-uswest --to-revision=1
```

ravi: logs after scale show fewer long waits, p99 trending down. sidecar backlog cleared on those nodes.

sam (oncall): metrics: p99 was 1.42s @1765506600, now 0.42s @1765507200. p95 steady at ~280ms.

kate: confirmed customer error-rate spike ~2.1% during the 6m window (timeouts and 504s). small set of heavy customers hit (regional).

megan: adding customer-impact tag to PD incident. please capture affected customers and timeline in the incident ticket.

sam (oncall): added timeline & affected customers to P-83921. marking status: mitigated. will follow up with postmortem and config-change guardrails.

ravi: root cause likely regression in batching heuristics in v2. follow-up: add e2e perf test + canary throttling for tiny-req workload.

kate: creating follow-up ticket in ops board for tests and a small runbook to toggle BATCH_MAX_PENDING quickly.

pagerduty: Incident P-83921 status changed to "Mitigated" by sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): handing off to night oncall @kate in 30m. leaving check: ensure p99 < 600ms for 15m and no new pages.

kate: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and escalate if it flares back. :thumbsup:

megan: thanks team. postmortem owner: ravi. please lock timeline and include the rollback decision and metrics.

incident-bot: thread archived to incidents channel once postmortem created."
